description:
Using the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app, check for drug-drug interactions between the cancer drug 'Bosutinib' and the immunosuppressant 'Ciclosporin' (also known as Cyclosporine). 

1. Search for and select 'Bosutinib' in the Cancer Drugs list.
2. Proceed to the Co-medications selection.
3. Find and select 'Ciclosporin' (look under Immunosuppressants category if browsing, or search directly).
4. View the interaction result.
5. Note the color of the interaction result (Red, Orange, Yellow, etc.) and any management advice displayed.
